subject: psychiatry
title: Sexual dysfunction, paraphilias and gender dysphoria

steps.tx: Clinicians classify **sexual dysfunction** by phase into desire, arousal, orgasm and pain disorders for assessment. Desire disorders include hypoactive desire while arousal disorders include erectile disorder and female arousal difficulty. Orgasm disorders include premature ejaculation, delayed ejaculation and anorgasmia in affected patients. Pain disorders include **genito pelvic pain penetration disorder**, vaginismus and dyspareunia during sexual activity. **Erectile dysfunction** in older men acts as a vascular sentinel and needs cardiovascular risk assessment.
steps.say: Clinicians classify sexual dysfunction by desire, arousal, orgasm and pain phases. Desire disorders are represented by low desire while arousal disorders are represented by erectile difficulty. Orgasm disorders include premature ejaculation, delayed ejaculation and absent orgasm sometimes. Erectile dysfunction in older men needs careful cardiovascular risk assessment always.

steps.tx: Assessment follows a **biopsychosocial approach** and explores onset, course, medical causes, medicines, substances and relationship factors without judgement. Situational failure with intact nocturnal erections points towards a psychological contribution in many men. Clinicians check diabetes, pelvic surgery, hormone problems and depression before attributing symptoms to anxiety. **PDE5 inhibitors** treat erectile disorder but clinicians must never combine them with nitrates. Treatment also includes sex therapy, sensate focus, psychological therapy and pelvic floor work for pain.
steps.say: Assessment explores medical causes, medicines, substances and relationship factors without judgement. Situational failure with intact nocturnal erections suggests a psychological contribution in men. Clinicians check diabetes, hormone problems and depression before attributing symptoms to anxiety. PDE5 inhibitors are effective for erectile disorder but combine dangerously with nitrate medicines.

steps.tx: **Gender dysphoria** means distress that arises from incongruence between experienced gender and assigned sex at birth. Gender nonconformity alone is not a disorder and becomes clinically relevant only when distress or impairment occurs. Care begins with **multidisciplinary assessment**, mental health support and careful exploration of goals and expectations. Eligible patients may receive puberty suppression, hormone treatment or surgery according to local protocol and persistence. Clinicians provide **fertility counselling** before treatment and actively support patients facing victimisation or suicide risk.
steps.say: Gender dysphoria means distress from incongruence between experienced gender and assigned sex. Gender nonconformity alone is not a disorder without distress or impairment present. Care begins with multidisciplinary assessment and mental health support for each patient. Clinicians provide fertility counselling before hormone treatment and support patients actively.

steps.tx: **Paraphilic disorders** involve intense atypical sexual interests that cause distress, impairment or harm to non consenting others. Paedophilic disorder involves minors and safeguarding plus legal duties dominate every clinical response immediately. Exhibitionistic, voyeuristic and frotteuristic disorders involve non consenting people and therefore need risk management. Consensual adult atypical interests without distress or harm do not constitute illness by themselves. Specialist care uses **relapse prevention**, psychological therapy and sometimes antiandrogen or antidepressant medicines for harmful disorders.
steps.say: Paraphilic disorders involve atypical interests that cause distress or harm to others. Paedophilic disorder involves minors and safeguarding duties dominate every clinical response immediately. Exhibitionistic and voyeuristic disorders involve non consenting people and need risk management. Consensual adult interests without distress or harm are not illness themselves.
